description: Clone a website's frontend (markup, original CSS, fonts, images, scroll animations) into a static preview plus Next.js and Astro projects, then score it against the original with pixel diffs at desktop and mobile widths. Takes ~1 minute per page (several minutes with build=true). Returns output paths and scores (percent identical).

build.description: Also npm install + build + score the generated apps (slow, default false)

pages.description: Crawl up to n same-site pages (default 1)

remove.description: CSS selectors to drop (cookie banners, chat widgets)

styling.description: css keeps the original stylesheet (default); tailwind converts class rules to Tailwind utilities wherever that renders identically and keeps the rest as CSS

verify.description: Score the clone against the original (default true)

waitMs.description: Extra wait after load in ms

name: clone_website
title: Clone website frontend
